# GitHub Actions

There are two separate workflows, which are as follows:

1. [Build, test, and publish CE](./build-test-and-publish-ce.yml) - runs on every push, PR, and manual dispatch to build and test the CE image (public) for all 3 environments (tomcat, wildfly, run). Any non-PR run (push to any branch, or `workflow_dispatch`) also publishes the image to Camunda's internal registry at `registry.camunda.cloud/team-cambpm` (public Docker Hub publishing ended). `wildfly-ee10` is not part of this automatic matrix yet - this workflow has no version-override mechanism (no `workflow_dispatch` inputs), so it always builds against the Dockerfile's fixed baseline `VERSION`, which predates WildFly EE10 support.
2. [Build and test EE](./build-and-test-ee.yml) - runs on PRs coming from within the repository (forks are excluded since it requires secrets) and on manual `workflow_dispatch`. PR runs only build and test the EE image (tomcat, wildfly, run) and don't publish; official EE publishing still goes through the `ci-cambpm` Jenkins instance. A manual `workflow_dispatch` run additionally pushes the per-arch images and the multi-arch manifests to `registry.camunda.cloud/cambpm-ee`, and requires an explicit `version`/`snapshot` input. It additionally supports `wildfly-ee10`, but only via `workflow_dispatch` with a `version`/`snapshot` that actually has WildFly EE10 support - `pull_request` runs skip that combination since they'd otherwise fall back to the same fixed baseline `VERSION`.
